about_the_game:
♟️ Strategic Like Chess. Playful Like Dominoes. Charming Like Carcassonne.

Planks and Arrows is a charming puzzle adventure where movement is governed by directional arrows on the ground—each one showing which direction you're allowed to move. Think of them like triangle-shaped signs pointing your way forward.

Need a new path? Place planks to extend or change your route and reach areas once out of reach. Every move matters in a world built on strategy and clever thinking.

Meet quirky characters, take on challenging quests, and uncover strange mysteries—but above all… find your beloved pet bird, Henry! 🐦

📜 Origins

Originally designed as a physical board game, Planks and Arrows began as a two-player match where players drew planks from a bag and built the playfield as they played—racing to reach each other’s base three times.

The video game brings that concept to life with expanded gameplay, a world full of stories, and puzzles that challenge your spatial reasoning.

🎮 Story Mode

Explore a whimsical world where everyone has a story—and sometimes a challenge. Some characters will test your skills in a match, while others need your help completing tasks that require smart use of a limited number of planks.

And in the middle of it all? A mystery: your bird Henry has gone missing. It's up to you to find out what happened.

⚔️ Quick Play

In the mood for pure strategy?

  • Play offline matches against AI or with local friends

  • Challenge others online in casual or ranked games

  • Outsmart opponents by building better paths and anticipating their moves.

  • With 20 planks drawn in random order, every match is a new puzzle waiting to be solved.

🎨 Customization

Make it your own:

  • Pick your favorite arena to battle in

  • Change how your planks look

  • Design your pawns to reflect your style

Whether you're exploring the story or climbing the leaderboard, Planks and arrows will offer you countless hours of strategic play.
